content.text: Cameron confronts cattle theft and Indigenous conspirators, arrests Eagle Feather, and maintains calm amid escalating rebellion. At the Big Horn Ranch, Dr. Martin treats an injured Indian boy while defending Mandy and Moira from drunken braves. Raven, an outlaw secretly loyal to Canada, saves cattle from destruction but dies after killing Little Thunder; Cameron honors him. Cameron later captures the Sioux agitator Copperhead after escaping imprisonment and fighting him on the Ghost River trail. Crowfoot’s loyalty helps prevent a wider uprising, while Canadian forces defeat the rebellion. Cameron returns to Fort Calgary with Copperhead. At the Big Horn Ranch, Dr. Martin discovers Moira does not love Smith and declares his love; she asks him to stay. The text then shifts to Evelyn’s diary, chronicling seventeenth-century English religious and political turmoil, persecution of Protestants, James II’s fall, William and Mary’s accession, and later European wars.
